wikipedia.title: Kune Falls
wikipedia.text: The Kune Falls is a waterfall at Khandala in Pune district in the Indian state of Maharashtra. It is the 14th highest waterfall in India.

wikipedia.title: Khandala railway station
wikipedia.text:
Khandala railway station is a local station for Khandala town, a twin hill stations of Lonavala – Khandala, in Pune district in Maharashtra, India. The Station code is KAD. It has three platforms,
It is the very next station (towards Pune) to Lonavala from where Pune Suburban Service starts. Khandala Ghat starts after this station towards Mumbai.
